# KhanaGharTak

> Jo Dil Chahe, Wahi Order Karo — online food delivery from verified restaurants and home kitchens in Shankargarh, Prayagraj, with upfront pricing and Cash on Delivery.

KhanaGharTak connects customers with local partner kitchens. Delivery is charged at a transparent per-kilometre rate plus a small fixed platform fee, with the full breakdown shown before you confirm an order. Average delivery time is around 35 minutes.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What KhanaGharTak is, how ordering works, and how to get started.
- [Restaurants](/restaurants): Verified partner restaurants and home kitchens currently delivering.
- [About](/about): Our story, service area and honest pricing approach.
- [Contact](/contact): Support email help@khanaghartak.in and phone +91 80092 53547.
